messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — pulled a shortlist of 12 potential design partners for the beta. Want input on recruitment criteria, interview script, and scope to promise for the pilot.
Ravi (SRE): 👍 Can you paste the shortlist? also need to know expected traffic patterns from each (qps, avg seq len) so we can size Dedicated vs hosted fallback.
Anya (PM): pasted in #links: https://tiny.redwood/dp-shortlist (sheet) — top 6 flagged for outreach. Most are mid-market SaaS and two fintechs. Expected qps range 0.5–10 per customer, seq len 64–512.
Tomo (Eng Lead): For beta scope I'd push for minimal surface area: chat + embeddings, no tool-calls or private connectors initially. That keeps runtime changes small. Can we limit to models <= 70B quantized?
Nora (CS): Agreed on scope. From a success perspective we need: 1) adoption (>=50 unique users across partners), 2) stability (SLOs met), 3) qualitative feedback loop (weekly issue logs).
Felix (Research): Add eval criteria: we should run a fixed prompt suite (50 prompts) weekly to track quality regressions and latency. Will prepare baseline metrics.
Sam (Legal): Heads-up: fintech partners will want explicit data handling terms. Recommend adding a short DPA checklist in the outreach packet. I can draft a one-pager.
recruiter-bot: Outreach templates ready: "DP Invite v1" and "DP NDA + DPA" uploaded to /recruitment/templates. Last edit by @maria-recruiting 2d ago.
Anya (PM): Draft interview script — please review quickly:
```
1) Quick intro (2min)
2) Current pain: what are you trying to build? (5min)
3) Workload profile: qps, avg tokens, peak patterns (3min)
4) Success signals: what would make this pilot successful for you? (5min)
5) Constraints: security, latency, data residency (3min)
6) Integration plan: timeline + engineering contacts (3min)
7) Willingness to run short evals/prompts and weekly feedback (2min)
```
Tomo (Eng Lead): Suggest adding one quick question about fallback behavior acceptance: "If hosted capacity is constrained, are you okay with routing to a smaller model or dedicated fallback?"
Anya (PM): Good call — I'll add. Also thinking about pilot length: propose 6 weeks active + 4 weeks opt-in extension. Thoughts?
Nora (CS): 6 weeks works. Build a joint success plan with each partner (baseline metrics + check-in cadence). We should offer one enablement session and a sandbox.
Ravi (SRE): For Dedicated sizing, mark partners with >2 qps at 256+ tokens as "Dedicated candidate". Others go hosted with rate-limited SLA. We'll provide expected P50/P95 latency numbers in the outreach.
Felix (Research): I'll own the prompt suite and automated regression alerts. Can we commit to weekly dashboard exports to partners?
Sam (Legal): I'll produce the DPA checklist and a simple opt-in clause for using anonymized logs for quality monitoring.
Anya (PM): Recruitment priority criteria (first-pass): product fit (must use embeddings or chat), willingness to be an active feedback partner, reasonable traffic (helps stress test), security fit (DPA acceptable).
Tomo (Eng Lead): Scope negotiation note: if a partner requires tool-calls early, we should treat that as a separate early-access path with extra engineering resource. Don't promise in the standard beta.
Nora (CS): Success metrics proposal to include in outreach: uptime >= 99% for core endpoints, regressions <= 5% drop in eval score vs baseline, NPS >= 7 at pilot end.
Anya (PM): Approve the outreach message + interview script? If yes, I'll start outreach tomorrow and set first calls for next week.
Ravi (SRE): Approve from infra side. I'll prep capacity notes and a short "what to expect" doc for partners.
Tomo (Eng Lead): Approve but flag that if three or more partners need >70B models we'll need to delay start by 2 weeks to provision.
Felix (Research): Approve. I'll drop the prompt suite link in the sheet.
Sam (Legal): Approve on condition I get 48hrs to review any partner-specific clauses.
recruiter-bot: Scheduled outreach batch: 6 partners, initial emails queued for 2027-01-12 10:00 UTC.
Anya (PM): Great — action items: 1) Nora: create enablement checklist + landing sandbox. 2) Ravi/Tomo: capacity note + fallback policy doc. 3) Felix: prompt suite + weekly dashboard export. 4) Sam: DPA checklist + review window. 5) Maria-recruiting: send templates and calendar invites. I'll update sheet and post summaries in #product-dp-updates.
Nora (CS): I'll take 1 and coordinate with Ops.
Tomo (Eng Lead): I'll start a draft fallback policy PR.
Ravi (SRE): I'll add capacity estimates to the sheet by EOD.
Anya (PM): Thanks everyone — ping me in thread if you hit blockers. :rocket:
